newsitem.title: UK: AIM shares rise after buoyant H1 results.
newsitem.headline: AIM shares rise after buoyant H1 results.

text.p: Shares in AIM Group Plc rose 36-1/2p to 405p on Tuesday after the company reported a rise in first-half profits and said it was confident about its full-year result.
AIM, which makes interiors and equipment for aircraft cabins and railway rolling stock, said its profit before tax had more than trebled to reach 2.8 million stg.

"Our range of products ... together with our reputation for quality, innovative design and project management, should ensure that we take full advantage of current market conditions," said chairman Jeff Smith.
"Against this background and the strong first half there is every expectation of an excellent full-year result," he added.
The group's turnover rose 49 percent to 36.1 million stg, with earnings per share up 112 percent at 15.3p. The interim dividend was doubled to 3.0p.
